title: W2: teams beside the roles, who is in them, and three new permissions
request: Build package W2 of the collaborative workspace: a team entity (Business, Data Science, ML Engineering, Sales, Marketing and others) with membership, on files and PostgreSQL, owner-only routes to manage teams, and the permissions contribute, approve_decision and contact_customers. A role says what a person may do; a team says whom an agent represents.
spec: Migration 0027 (team: id, workspace_id, name, kind, created, name unique per workspace; team_membership: team_id, user_id, since, primary key (team_id, user_id)); storage/teams.py FileTeams and PgTeams behind the Teams Protocol and open_teams (create_team, teams, team, add_member, remove_member, remove_user, teams_of, is_member, counts); routes GET/POST /api/workspace/teams, POST /api/workspace/teams/{team_id}/members, DELETE /api/workspace/teams/{team_id}/members/{user_id}; PERMISSIONS contribute (owner, data_scientist), approve_decision (owner), contact_customers (nobody); leaving a workspace leaves its teams; storage migrate moves a folder's teams.
plan: Read the storage Protocol pattern (memory bases, team work), the accounts guard, roles and members routes
Migration 0027 after 0026 and the two tables in storage/models.py
FileTeams and PgTeams with one contract, open_teams and the Teams Protocol
Permissions in accounts/roles.py; route words and SPECIAL entries in accounts/guard.py
The teams router, its request and response models, the regenerated client
Tests on files and PostgreSQL: a person in two teams, removal, a viewer refused, another workspace seeing nothing
Adversarial review by dclab-reviewer, fixes, record, commit after W4

decisions.decision: Teams are a new table beside membership, not new roles
decisions.why: the owner's decision: a role is what a person may do, a team is whom an agent represents; the CHECK on membership.role stays as it is

decisions.decision: kind is a lowercase word checked by a pattern, the five plan kinds as labels, no CHECK
decisions.why: kind is configuration; a workspace may add a Finance team without a migration
GET /api/teams already lists the 28.8 team walks; the members routes are under /api/workspace

decisions.decision: Listing teams is read for every member; creating teams and placing people is admin (the owner)
decisions.why: agents and pages of every role need to know which teams exist; managing them is the owner's

decisions.decision: A member is an account and a member of the workspace; without sign-in people are not placed (409), teams are still made
decisions.why: without accounts the local owner is the only person, so a membership would name nobody; the agents still need teams

decisions.decision: Leaving a workspace removes the person's teams there in the same transaction (remove_member and sync_memberships)
decisions.why: a team must never keep someone who can no longer act in the workspace

decisions.decision: Team changes are audited as role_change rows with team_* moves; no experience event yet
decisions.why: the audit kinds and the experience vocabulary are closed lists; the experience kinds live in dclab_core, outside this package's files

decisions.decision: No rename or delete route in W2
decisions.why: the package lists create, list, add, remove, teams of a user and is_member; renaming and deleting a team is left for the owner to ask

change: dclab_rnd/storage/migrations/versions/0027_teams.py (new), dclab_rnd/storage/models.py (team, team_membership), dclab_rnd/storage/teams.py (new), dclab_rnd/storage/__init__.py (Teams, open_teams), dclab_rnd/storage/migrate.py (_teams), dclab_rnd/accounts/roles.py, dclab_rnd/accounts/guard.py, dclab_rnd/accounts/store.py (leave_teams), dclab_rnd/agentic/routers/teams.py (new) and routers/__init__.py, dclab_rnd/agentic/api_models.py, generated web/src/api.js and static/app/js/api.js, docs/DATA_CATALOG.md and docs/data_catalog.json (generated), tests/test_teams.py (new).

findings.defect: A kind written with a space was accepted although the test expected a refusal.
findings.scenario: POST /api/workspace/teams with kind 'no way' answered 201 in test_without_sign_in_teams_are_made_but_people_are_not_placed.
findings.cause: normal_kind turns spaces and hyphens into underscores on purpose, so 'no way' is the valid kind 'no_way'; the test's example was wrong, not the code.
findings.fix: the test uses 'ops!' as its invalid kind

findings.defect: The data catalog could not be built after the team table was added.
findings.scenario: python -m dclab_rnd.data_catalog stopped with 'table team has no description'; test_data_catalog errored four times.
findings.cause: data_catalog reads a table's description only from a comment on its sa.Table( line; the team table's description was in a block comment above it.
findings.fix: a comment on the sa.Table( line of team and team_membership; the catalog regenerated

findings.defect: Migration 0027 names 0026 as its parent while 0026 (W4) was uncommitted.
findings.scenario: Committing W2 alone would make every upgrade fail with 'Can't locate revision 0026'.
findings.cause: W2 and W4 were built at the same time in one tree; W4's migration was not in HEAD.
findings.fix: W2 is committed after W4's commit, as agreed with the session building W4; the chain stays 0024, 0026, 0027
findings.test: tests/test_storage_postgres.py (models against migrations on a fresh database)

findings.defect: The store placed an account in a team without checking it belongs to the workspace, and a removal racing the insert could leave a membership behind.
findings.scenario: A non-route caller (an agent tool) adds an outsider; or the owner adds Dana while another request removes Dana from the workspace: the route check passes, leave_teams deletes nothing, then the insert lands.
findings.cause: The workspace check was only in the route, in another transaction.
findings.fix: PgTeams.add_member selects the membership row FOR KEY SHARE in the insert's transaction and refuses a person who is not a member; a concurrent removal waits and its leave_teams sees the new row

findings.defect: A broken teams file put the server's absolute path in an HTTP answer, and invalid JSON was a 500.
findings.scenario: A hand-edited teams.json of the wrong shape: POST /api/workspace/teams answered 422 with '/var/folders/.../teams/teams.json is not a teams file'.
findings.cause: FileTeams._load put the path in the TeamError text, and JSONDecodeError was not caught.
findings.fix: BrokenTeamsFile with no path in its message for any unreadable file; the routes answer 503; the file is never overwritten

findings.defect: The two stores compared team names differently.
findings.scenario: With 'Straße' saved, 'STRASSE' was refused on files (casefold) and accepted on PostgreSQL (lower).
findings.cause: FileTeams used str.casefold, PgTeams used SQL lower().
findings.fix: PgTeams reads the workspace's names under its advisory lock and compares with casefold, as the files do

findings.defect: storage migrate did not move a file workspace's teams.
findings.scenario: Teams made without sign-in on files were lost when the workspace moved to PostgreSQL.
findings.cause: migrate.py had no step for teams/teams.json.
findings.fix: _teams moves every team with its id, name, kind and time once (import_team skips an id or name already there); memberships are counted, not moved, since a file workspace has no accounts

findings.defect: Team changes do not reach the session record (experience log).
findings.scenario: Creating a team or placing a person writes an audit row only; the experience log has no team event.
findings.cause: dclab_core.experience.KINDS is a closed vocabulary and audit role_change rows are not mirrored into it; dclab_core is outside this package's files.
findings.fix: left open: add team.created, team.member_added and team.member_removed (ids only) to dclab_core.experience.KINDS in a later package and emit them from the routes

findings.defect: Tests did not cover the store's refusal of an outsider, leaving the workspace over HTTP, the casefold parity or a broken file.
findings.scenario: The first test file passed while findings W2-4, W2-5 and W2-6 were possible.
findings.cause: The tests followed the happy paths of the routes.
findings.fix: tests for each: outsider refused by the store, DELETE /api/workspace/members removes the person's teams, Straße/STRASSE on both stores, broken files on the store and over HTTP

findings.defect: No route renames or deletes a team.
findings.scenario: A mistyped team name stays, since names are unique per workspace.
findings.cause: The package listed create, list, add and remove member only.
findings.fix: left for the owner to ask for

measurements.name: tests/test_teams.py on files and on PostgreSQL
measurements.gate: every test passes with no skip on both stores, run through tests/run_parallel.py with and without --pg
measurements.result: 15 tests passed on files and 15 on PostgreSQL (0 skipped); test_accounts 19 and test_storage_migrate 9 passed on PostgreSQL
measurements.next: W3 team agents on the shared problem
limits: no concurrency test runs a removal and an insert at the same moment; the lock is shown by reading the code
no model is involved in W2

measurements.name: generated client is fresh
measurements.result: passed after the build added listTeams, createTeam, addTeamMember, removeTeamMember and four types
measurements.next: a page for teams when the owner asks
limits: no page calls the new routes yet

outcome: Teams exist beside the roles on files and PostgreSQL; the owner makes them and places members of the workspace in them; every member can list them; another workspace sees none of them; leaving a workspace leaves its teams; contribute, approve_decision and contact_customers are in the permission table (nobody may contact customers by default).
lessons: A check the route makes and the store does not is a check another caller skips; the rule belongs in the store's transaction.
When two stores must behave the same, compare names with the same function in both, not a database function that looks equal.
An error message that reaches an HTTP answer must not hold a server path.
A migration chain shared with parallel work must be committed in its order; agree the order before committing.
risks: Team changes are audited but not in the experience log until the vocabulary has team events (W2-8).
Team names cannot be changed or a team removed through the API (W2-10).
The new permissions are in the table only; no route or agent demands contribute, approve_decision or contact_customers yet (W3, W5).
